name: yof
description: Security checks for code written with AI builders, in VS Code, Cursor and Windsurf: leaked secrets and made-up packages in Problems as you save, with a fix prompt to paste into your AI assistant. Accept a risk with a reason, attack your own app, get a signed report with an SBOM. Local rules, no telemetry unless you opt in.
author: Mondaily

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a workspace you have not trusted, yof runs only its own bundled CLI (never one from the project) and yof attack is off.

yof.checkOnSave.description: Run yof check on the workspace folder when you save a file.

yof.packageLookups.description: Also check dependencies against npm, PyPI and OSV (package names and pinned versions are sent to those registries). Off: yof makes no network call at all.

enumDescriptions: Use the profile in .yof.yml (balanced when there is none)
What to fix now and this week
Everything, including public keys that are fine

yof.cliPath.description: A yof executable to run. Empty: the project's own node_modules/.bin/yof, otherwise the copy bundled with this extension.

yof.checkTimeoutSeconds.description: Stop a check that takes longer than this.

yof.attack.target.description: The address yof attack tests: localhost, or a preview or live host you have proven is yours (see .yof/attack.json).

yof.attack.config.description: The attack config, relative to the workspace folder. It names your app, your consent and the test accounts.

enumDescriptions: Every attack group, with test records it creates and deletes

yof.attack.envFile.description: A KEY=VALUE file with your test accounts' variables. Only names starting with YOF_ are read. Keep it out of git.

yof.shareScanCount.description: Help yof count scans: after each finished scan, send only 'a scan finished', the extension version, the editor's name and the day. No code, file names or paths. Off by default, and always off while your editor's telemetry setting is off.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out yof.vsix
